title: kate-fileio: open a regular file before reading it
summary: load checks is_file on the path before File::open. A directory and a FIFO are not read. The FIFO test uses mkfifo and a timeout of about 5 seconds. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust in kate-fileio. Linux CI runs the tests. The FIFO test is cfg unix. It does not need a window.

definitions.definition: pub fn load(path: &std::path::Path, opts: &DecodeOptions) -> Result<Loaded, LoadError>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Check path metadata is_file before File::open. A missing path returns LoadError::Io. A path that is not a regular file returns LoadError::Io and open is not called. A directory is not a regular file. A FIFO is not a regular file. Then open the regular file and read it as load does today. Keep the existing digest test. Add a unix-only FIFO test. The test creates the FIFO by running the mkfifo command through std::process::Command. It adds no new dependency. The test runs load on a thread. The timeout is about 5 seconds. A regression fails. The call does not hang. The result is Err. Leave decode.rs and workspace.rs unchanged. Leave layout.rs and notice.rs unchanged. PKT-0069 owns those files. Leave paint.rs unchanged. PKT-0071 owns that file. Leave fold.rs and view.rs unchanged. PKT-0073 owns those files. Leave command.rs and workspace.rs unchanged. PKT-0074 owns those files. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: load::tests::a_fifo_returns_promptly
regression_tests.asserts: This test is cfg unix. It fails on main because load can open a FIFO and block. The test creates the FIFO with the mkfifo command through std::process::Command. It adds no new dependency. load runs on a thread. The timeout is about 5 seconds. The result is Err. The call does not hang.
